note: The SHAPES are recorded from real Linear calls: read-only reads of a real team, one real create with a client-chosen id (it filed a needed item and landed in Triage), the same create sent again, and one rejected label update. The VALUES are synthesized: label ids, project ids and names, the item's id, identifier and url, and the team id. Only the generic label families and one bare label are kept. The created-read answer carries archivedAt and the state type, so a keyed item that closed or was archived is told apart from an open one.

Only one label in a group can be applied to an issue. | EXPLANATION: The provided label_ids contain multiple labels from the same exclusive label group. In Linear, labels can be organized into groups where only ONE label from each group can be applied to an issue. To fix this: (1) Use LINEAR_LIST_LINEAR_LABELS with team_id to see label relationships (check isGroup and parent fields), (2) Identify which labels share the same parent group, (3) Select only ONE label per group.
